opening.argument: The speaker presents BitClub Network as an exceptional opportunity and urges people to join, describing participants recruiting others and saying people “have to join big cloud because that is the biggest opportunity there is.” He turns that pitch into a recruitment workflow, telling viewers to commit daily, make calls, and follow up. The offer is tied to cryptocurrency mining through buying mining equipment or joining the company’s pool, while the speaker associates joining with becoming rich within three years and promotes the Club Coin’s near-term price. Together, recruitment-dependent income, paid mining participation, and a time-limited wealth claim establish a recruitment-driven scheme, not merely discussion of cryptocurrency or reporting on a scheme.
